supabaseUrl.title: Supabase Project URL
supabaseUrl.description: https://<project-ref>.supabase.co for this client's Supabase project.

supabaseServiceKey.title: Supabase service_role Key
supabaseServiceKey.description: service_role key (bypasses RLS). Store only in the task's saved input.

apifyToken.title: Apify API Token
apifyToken.description: Apify account token. Required to look up the most recent scraper run and read its dataset.

scraperTaskId.title: Scraper Task ID
scraperTaskId.description: The client's scraper task this writer consumes. Used to auto-discover the latest SUCCEEDED run when datasetId is omitted.

datasetId.title: Apify Dataset ID (optional)
datasetId.description: Explicit dataset to process (used for backfills). If omitted, the most recent successful scraper run is used.

testMode.title: Test Mode
testMode.description: If true, process only the first 5 items and print full debug output.
